full_sentence: Although the sample size was small, the findings were widely cited in later research.

options.text: because the findings were widely cited in later research.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' expresses cause, which conflicts with the contrast that 'although' introduces.

options.why_wrong: This adds background about the researchers but does not set up a contrast with the limitation in the first clause.
